added.member: UI documents: per-corner, elliptical and % border-radius, and corner-shape
added.summary: border-radius takes four corners, the elliptical / form and percentages, with border-<corner>-radius longhands and logical corner names; corner-shape and its longhands take round, squircle, bevel, scoop, notch, square and superellipse(). Backgrounds, borders, outlines, shadows and overflow clips follow the corners. og-render: UiCorner::Css(UiCssCorners) gives a rectangle elliptical radii and a superellipse per corner.
